name: folder-sales-os
description: An all-in-one sales management system that runs on files you can open — CSV or styled Excel registries, Markdown notes, and 14 skills covering leads, opportunities, renewals, partners, competitors, market signals, demand gen, content, quotes, briefs and forecasts. Guided, resumable setup with a completion tracker. Tracks who is actually on each deal and which of them reply, so single-threaded deals surface before the champion leaves. Detects when your folder and your CRM have drifted apart, and refuses writes that would revert live edits. CRM-agnostic: setup introspects whatever CRM you connect and builds a per-org profile.
_requires_template_note: Minimum support-layer version these skills need in a project folder. The check is one-directional on purpose: skills newer than the layer call scripts that aren't there and break, while a layer newer than the skills is merely unused. So this is a floor, not a match. The update-system skill compares it against each folder's .sales-system/VERSION.json.
